rules.plainEnglish: Enterprise VIP Platinum customers receive automatic flat billing of $8,999/mo and are exempt from coupon stacking.
rules.codeSnippet:
elif tier == "VIP_PLATINUM":
            # Hidden rule: VIP Platinum gets flat $8,999
            subtotal = 8999.00
            exempt_from_stacking = True
rules.implication: Flat rate pricing must be preserved in async billing engine.

rules.plainEnglish: Invoices with grand totals of $50,000 or greater mandate dual-manager compliance sign-off.
rules.implication: High-value transactions must enter pending compliance state.

rules.plainEnglish: Invoices overdue by more than 30 days incur a 2% compounding late penalty fee.
